address: 79 Hang Dieu Street, Cua Dong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, 11000, Vietnam
bio: For over a decade, this small shop has been known for its crispy bánh xèo pancake with various fillings. For first-timers, English-speaking servers helpfully explain how the pancake is wrapped in rice paper with veggies and herbs, and dunked in the tangy fish sauce before being consumed. In addition to the signature pancake, hot pot, spring roll, rice noodles and barbecues are their strong suits....
